preconditions.description: The number of strings k must be between 1 and 26.
The length of the string q must be between 1 and 100.
The string q must consist of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: If no beautiful sequence exists, the output must be 'NO'.
If a beautiful sequence exists, the output must start with 'YES' followed by k lines of strings.

postconditions.expression: all(s[0] != t[0] for s, t in zip(stdout.splitlines()[1:], stdout.splitlines()[2:]))
postconditions.description: The first characters of the strings in the beautiful sequence must be distinct.
